# DS-QM030-PROJECTION-POSTULATE-AND-BORN-PAIRING-IMPORT

Diagonal effects in [0,1] need not be projectors. Native repeated application keeps E²-E and compares normalized linear weights with normalized squared weights on the same supplied carrier. A hardcoded seven-pairing count, route index, provider PASS annotation or source theorem name is excluded as a Born-selection proof.

Supported: Scalar idempotence holds exactly at 0 and 1 in Lean; retained diagonal effect controls and two different normalized pairings are exact.

Remaining: Derive or explicitly admit the spectral/projector structure and the physical observer pairing. The bare finite carrier does not select the Born rule or an actual event.
